nodes.description: Private owner address of DogeWorldToken; set to msg.sender in constructor and used in privileged require checks.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances; decremented in transferFrom without SafeMath and set in approve.
Address whitelisted in ensure() and set by setTradeAddress (owner only).
Mapping deciding which addresses bypass the sale-condition checks inside ensure().
Per-address sale counter, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Minimum transfer amount configured by init().
Maximum transfer amount configured by init().
Maximum number of sales per address configured by init().
Total token supply scaled by decimals, assigned in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balanceOf directly with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view whitelist check reading owner, tradeAddress, canSale and the computed UNI pair, then calling condition().
Internal view sale restriction check reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only batch transfer performing unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance mutations in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address computation using keccak256 and a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and balances, and granting unlimited allowance to the router.
Private SafeERC20 helper doing a low-level call to an external token and decoding optional return data.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership assignment and transfer origins.
Unsafe arbitrary delegatecall executed in delegate() on an attacker-influenceable target address.
Unsafe low-level address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn with external token contracts.
Raw subtraction of allowance and balanceOf in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Raw multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend without SafeMath.
Local variable _UNI holding the computed pair address in ensure().
Local variable pair (computed address) in pairFor().

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender to transferFrom inside transfer, so caller identity flows into transfer.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is compared against _from and used to consume allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], letting the caller arbitrarily set allowances for itself.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor() to build the whitelist.
ensure() reads owner to allow the owner to bypass sale restrictions.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass condition.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of allowed sales.
transferFrom() performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with raw subtraction, which underflows if the check is bypassed.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
The unchecked subtraction of allowance and balance entries in transferFrom feeds the raw arithmetic operation node.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner, gating a dangerous delegatecall on the untrusted caller identity.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) to an arbitrary address chosen by the privileged caller.
callOptionalReturn() performs a low-level external call to the token contract, which can re-enter during safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale parameters.
init() sets _minSale using token*(10**decimals) with raw arithmetic.
init() sets _maxSale using maxToken*(10**decimals) with raw arithmetic.
init() sets _saleNum to the caller-supplied saleNum.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner, gating mass balance manipulation on caller identity.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic in a loop.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before overwriting the trade whitelist address.
setTradeAddress() writes the caller-supplied addr into tradeAddress.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, tying privileges to the deployer address.
Constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
Constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][router] = uint(-1), granting unlimited router allowance.
Local _UNI is computed and compared against _from inside ensure().
Local total is produced by the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Loop index i drives the recipient iteration in batchSend().
Local _to indexes balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop.
Local pair is the address returned by pairFor() and consumed by ensure().
Local token0 orders the token addresses before hashing in pairFor().
Local token1 orders the token addresses before hashing in pairFor().

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to exists only inside transfer() and is forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _value exists only inside transfer() and is forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _from is consumed by transferFrom() for allowance, ensure and balance updates.
Parameter _to is consumed by transferFrom() for the recipient balance update.
Parameter _value is consumed by transferFrom() for allowance and balance arithmetic.
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key in approve().
Parameter _value is only stored as the allowance amount in approve().
Parameter _from is used in the whitelist comparisons inside ensure().
Parameter _value is forwarded to condition() inside ensure().
Parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
Parameter _value is compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Parameter a is the target of the delegatecall in delegate().
Parameter b is the calldata of the delegatecall in delegate().
Parameter saleNum is assigned to _saleNum inside init().
Parameter token determines _minSale inside init().
Parameter maxToken determines _maxSale inside init().
Parameter _tos is the recipient array iterated in batchSend().
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend().
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Parameter factory is hashed into the pair address in pairFor().
Parameter tokenA is ordered and hashed in pairFor().
Parameter tokenB is ordered and hashed in pairFor().
Parameter _name is assigned to the name state variable in the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
Parameter _supply defines totalSupply and the initial balance in the constructor.
Local _UNI is computed and used only within ensure() as a whitelist condition.
Local total is the unchecked product computed inside batchSend().
Loop index i exists only inside the batchSend() loop.
Loop-local recipient _to exists only inside batchSend().
Local pair is the return value computed inside pairFor().
Local token0 is an ordering temporary inside pairFor().
Local token1 is an ordering temporary inside pairFor().
